compose_two_graphs: compose two GTN graphs together to produce a combined weighted finite-state transducer
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a GTN graph for all paths from start to accept nodes
compute_viterbi_path: compute the Viterbi best path through a GTN graph and return the highest-scoring path
concatenate_graphs: concatenate multiple GTN graphs in sequence to chain their languages together
remove_epsilon_transitions: remove epsilon transitions from a GTN graph and relink the remaining arcs
